Artículo l. Establecer el procedimiento de reconocimiento automático de registro sanitario 
de Medicamentos para uso humano a todo los productos fabricados y registrados en países 
que cuenten con autoridades reguladoras que forman parte de la lista de autoridades de la 
Organización Mundial de la Salud (WLA, por sus siglas en inglés). 
Para la obtención del registro sanitario bajo el procedimiento de reconocimiento, no será 
requerido el análisis de laboratorio previo, siempre y cuando el producto haya sido registrado 
y comercializado en países con autoridad regulatoria de la lista de autoridades de la 
Organización Mundial de la Salud (WLA, por sus siglas en inglés).

translation_review.raw_machine_translation: Article 1. To set up an automatic procedure for the registration of medicinal products for human use for all products manufactured and registered in countries with regulatory authorities that are listed as WLA authorities. To obtain a health registration under the recognition procedure, prior laboratory analysis will not be required as long as the product has been registered and placed on the market in countries with regulatory authority from the World Health Organization (WLA) list of authorities.
translation_review.checked_translation: Article 1. An automatic sanitary-registration procedure for medicines for human use is established for all products manufactured and registered in countries whose regulatory authorities are on the WLA list. To obtain sanitary registration under recognition, prior laboratory analysis shall not be required, provided the product is registered and marketed in countries whose regulatory authority is on the World Health Organization's WLA list.
translation_review.check_note: Checked manufactured AND registered, marketed condition, human-medicine scope and conditional laboratory exemption.

Artículo 7. La Dirección Nacional de Farmacia y Drogas verificada que la solicitud de 
registro sanitario automático del medicamento a registrar, corresponde al registrado en la 
autoridad reguladora que forma parte de la lista de autoridades de la Organización Mundial 
de la Salud (WLA, por sus siglas en inglés), que el tipo de producto a registrar (vacuna u otro 
tipo de medicamento) esté incluido en dicha lista y que la autoridad reguladora tiene todas 
las funciones regulatorias aprobadas por la OMS para ese tipo de medicamento, la Dirección, 
en el término máximo de diez (10) días hábiles a partir de la recepción de la solicitud o de 
su corrección y el pago del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas, le asignará el número de 
registro sanitario de manera automática y concederá el respectivo Certificado de Registro 
Sanitario como reconocimiento del Registro Sanitario extranjero, utilizando el formato 
establecido.

translation_review.raw_machine_translation: Article 7. The National Bureau for Pharmacy and Drugs verified that the application for automatic health registration of the medicinal product to be registered corresponds to that registered with the regulatory authority that forms part of the list of authorities of the World Health Organization (WLA), that the type of product to be registered (vaccine or other type of medicinal product) is included in that list and that the regulatory authority has all the regulatory functions approved by the WHO for that type of medicine, and that the Section shall, with a maximum period of ten (10) working days after receipt of the application or its correction and payment by the Ministry of Health and Health Registry as established, assign to them the national Health Registry and Health and Health registration as their respective form.
translation_review.checked_translation: Article 7. After the National Directorate of Pharmacy and Drugs verifies that the medicine's automatic-registration application corresponds to the product registered by a regulatory authority on the WHO WLA list, that the product type (vaccine or other medicine) is included in that list and that the authority has all WHO-approved regulatory functions for that product type, the Directorate shall, within a maximum of ten (10) working days from receipt of the application or its correction and payment to the Ministry of Economy and Finance, automatically assign the sanitary-registration number and grant the corresponding Sanitary Registration Certificate in recognition of the foreign registration, using the established format.
translation_review.check_note: Material repair: restored verify/type/function conditions and clear grant clause; preserved payment/correction trigger and working days.
